LEGACION DE CHILE

**〔此处转录不清〕**

Shanghai, December 30, 1935.

Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
P.O. Box 158,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I am in receipt of your letter of the 25th instant
and thank you very much for the inquiries you have made
concerning Gustave V. Starborn.

In my turn, if I have any informations about the
above mentionned, who gave false indications regarding
his supposed stay in Shanghai, I will immediately let you
know, as I have already promised to do so to Mr. Henchman
and Mr. Mackay during their last visit to the Legation.

I remain,
Sir,
Sincerely yours.

E. Vega
Chargé d'Affaires for Chile
pages.zh:
智利公使馆

**〔此处转录不清〕**

上海，1935年12月30日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海公共租界工部局，
邮政信箱158号，
上海。

先生：

兹收到贵处本月25日来信，非常感谢贵处就 Gustave V. Starborn 一事所进行的查询。

若我获得有关上述人士的任何信息——此人就其所谓在上海逗留的情况提供了虚假线索——我将立即通知贵处，正如我在 Henchman 先生和 Mackay 先生上次访问公使馆时已承诺的那样。

此致
敬礼

E. Vega
智利代办

December 25, 5.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
dated December 10, 1935, and to inform you that no
trace can be found of Gustave V. Starborn, or of any
individual who ever met or knew him in Shanghai or
elsewhere. In the course of the inquiries about
Starborn, the Police visited various local chemical
enterprises, the Danish Consulate and the French
Police. There does not appear to be any firm here called
the Shanghai Laboratory.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Acting Commissioner of Police.

E. Vega, Esq.,
Charge d'Affaires for Chile,
Shanghai.

JMS

1935年12月25日。

先生：

谨此提及您1935年12月10日来信，并告知贵处，未能发现 Gustave V. Starborn 的任何踪迹，也未找到在上海或其他地方曾与其会面或认识他的任何人。在关于 Starborn 的调查过程中，警方走访了本地多家化学企业、丹麦领事馆以及法国巡捕房。此处似乎没有名为“上海实验室”的机构。

此致
敬礼

（签名）K. M. Bourne.
代理警务处长。

E. Vega 先生，
智利代办，
上海。

JMS

REPORT
File No. **〔此处转录不清〕**
S. B. **〔此处转录不清〕**
Date December 23 1935.

Subject Gustave V. Starborn. — Communication dated 17/12/35
from Chargé d'affaires for Chile. —
Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Exhaustive enquiries have failed to discover any trace
of G. V. Starborn or of his having been known to anyone in
Shanghai. Local chemical concerns have no knowledge of him
and enquiries at the Scandinavian Consulate proved fruitless.
There is no record of him in either S.M.P. or French Police
files. The Chilean Government's representative, when
interviewed by the undersigned, could add nothing to the meagre
information contained in his communication except that he
believed that Starborn was now travelling in Chile.

D Henchman
D. P. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

特务科第二股。
报告
档案编号 **〔此处转录不清〕**
S. B. **〔此处转录不清〕**
日期 1935年12月23日。

事由：Gustave V. Starborn。—— 来自智利代办的1935年12月17日照会。——
由副警务处长（特务科）Henchman 办理 转呈者 **〔此处转录不清〕**

经详尽查询，未能发现 G. V. Starborn 的任何踪迹，亦无人知晓其在上海的行踪。本地化学商行对其一无所知，向斯堪的纳维亚领事馆进行的查询也毫无结果。在上海公共租界工部局警务处或法国巡捕房的档案中均无其记录。当卑职面谈智利政府代表时，除认为 Starborn 目前正在智利旅行外，该代表未能在其照会所载的寥寥信息之外提供更多内容。

D Henchman
副警务处长（特务科）

pages.en:
LEGACION DE CHILE

**〔此处转录不清：右上角手写批注及方框印记〕**

Shanghai, December 10, 1935.

Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have just received cabled instructions from my Government requesting me to send a report concerning Mr. Gustave V. Starborn, who travels with a danish passport and who gives as reference the " Shanghai Laboratory ".

The Consulate General of Denmark has no one bearing that name on its register; the local danish consulate has therefore never delivered a passport to a person named Starborn in the last five years at least.

I beg you to let me know if you have any informations in your files regarding a person named Starborn and if you could order an immediate and very urgent inquiry to be made regarding this matter, so as to enable me to answer by cable, as soon as I get your answer, to my Government.

Thanking you in advance,

I am, dear Sir,

Your obedient servant.

E. Vega
Chargé d'Affaires for Chile
pages.zh:
智利公使馆

**〔此处转录不清：右上角手写批注及方框印记〕**

上海，1935年12月10日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

先生：

谨此告知，我刚刚收到本国政府发来的电报指示，要求我就 Gustave V. Starborn 先生提交一份报告。该人持丹麦护照旅行，并以“上海实验室”作为推荐参考。

丹麦总领事馆的登记册中并无此名之人；因此，当地丹麦领事馆在过去至少五年内从未向名为 Starborn 的人签发过护照。

恳请贵处告知，贵处档案中是否有关于名为 Starborn 之人的任何信息，以及能否下令就此事项立即进行紧急调查，以便我在收到贵处答复后，能尽快以电报回复我国政府。

预先致谢，

此致
亲爱的先生，

您的恭顺仆人。

E. Vega
智利代办
